notes: The original worker task explicitly permits material-only delivery. No CompCertTSO binary execution or Coq 8.3 proof replay is claimed.
The author documentation excludes out-of-memory errors. This is not a correctness proof for unrestricted modern C++ atomics, ARM or RISC-V.

Two literal admit tactics occur in common/Memcomp.v at lines 630 and 632, in a file listed by the upstream Makefile. They are preserved and indexed; this delivery does not certify all upstream proof targets.

The upstream README pins Coq 8.3pl1/pl2, OCaml 3.12.0 (or 3.11) and optional Ott 0.20.3 for regeneration. These historical execution dependencies are documented, not silently replaced by the Coq 8.4 toolkit used for CompCertSSA.
